Final prototype

Studio opens on the large graph canvas, Current retains its orbit graph, and Signal uses the angular network. The wider Focus reader is available in all three themes.

Try Vertical on any board, Focus mode in any reader, and Commands from each workspace.

About this review file

This self-contained artifact contains three shortlisted interface studies, each with Kanban, Reader and Graph. It uses example tasks, knowledge and declared relationships. It is not connected to the live RKE runtime.

Search, filters, graph selection, graph navigation and the original prototype controls run locally. Node selection does not verify knowledge or change task records. Each embedded view is isolated in a sandbox and cannot make network requests.

Style guidance: minimalist-ui, high-end-visual-design and industrial-brutalist-ui, adapted to working application screens. No official component system or accessibility certification is claimed.
